cases.name: Shavon Randle
cases.narrative: She was kidnapped in retribution for someone else allegedly stealing marijuana. He shot her 4 times in the head, cheek, breast and stomach. Her severely decomposed body was found wearing only her bra and underwear in an abandoned house in Oak Cliff. Shavon’s DNA was found on a necktie, a towel and a cord that was apparently used to tie her up.
